evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep skips the standard framing entirely. Opens with 'I was calling to see if you had about fifteen minutes to walk through a possible move for to this weekend on the twenty seventh' but never states the promise of a dependable quote or waits for explicit buy-in.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep moves directly into probing: 'before I kind of dive in too deep do you have just like any top of mind, concerns or questions I can answer right off the top?' — this is a throwaway question, not the genuine version that asks what they want answered on this specific call.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer never raised a concern to follow up on.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep thoroughly probes: storage unit address, size (10x20), items (bed frames, mattresses, couch, tires, boxes, TVs), house address, items from house (mattresses, dresser, couch, bookshelf, washer/dryer, TVs with sizes), TV mounting status, fragile items, box count at house (3-4 totes), additional stops, and access/parking at all three locations.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. No mention of packing services.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Asked at storage unit ('approximately how many boxes') and at house ('any boxes at the house'). Told 5-6 totes at storage and 3-4 at house.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives hourly rate ($192 for two movers) and estimates 3-4 hours based on items listed, mentions $2.5 minimum ('if we're around that minimum, but $2 and a half to $3 then that's all you pay for anyway'). Personalizes to 'minimal items' and references previous Wednesday move that took 3-3.5 hours. Missing the explicit range framing ('typical box count for a home your size').
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip/overnight fees not disclosed. Mentions $2.5 minimum and 'only pay for the time you use' but does not use the 'not a guess' or '15-minute increments' framing from the script.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Rep moves directly to slot availability and booking without gauging customer reaction to pricing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not close Section 5 at all.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep moves to confirmation email and sign-off without any final concerns probe.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. No recognizable version of 'Would you like our help with your move?' Rep assumes booking: 'I will be sending a confirmation email over to you as well right now' without an explicit consent ask.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirms date (September 27th), time window (12:30-1:00 PM), and sends confirmation email. Does NOT confirm: phone number, arrival window clarity (window is already stated), crew size, addresses clarity (inferred but not explicitly re-confirmed as part of booking), or notes for crew about customer concerns (none were raised, so none were documented).

top_strength: Chauntelle gathered extraordinarily thorough logistics details across three locations—storage unit dimensions, all furniture pieces, TV sizes and mounting status, box counts, access issues—building a clear, itemized picture that directly informed the estimate.
coaching_note: Skip the conversational open and move directly to the two load-bearing scripts: deliver the quid-pro-quo framing ('10-15 minutes, walk away with a quote you can depend on') with a real pause for yes, then ask the genuine version of Their Agenda ('Other than price, what are your biggest concerns and what do you want answers to?') before any probing begins.
